segments.title: Hype Train Cold Open: Aladdin and DuckTales Beat Freestyle
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on; Hype Train commandeers feed for 18 minutes of Aladdin/DuckTales trap beat freestyles, thanking subscribers Apple Daffol, Bundlesprout, Sporify, and others while riffing on 'getting blown inside himself' and demanding beat switches.

segments.title: News Desk: GDP Contraction, Ukraine Minerals Deal, Peter Gibbon Rat Infestation
segments.notes: Case attempts news coverage of Q1 2025 US GDP shrinking 0.3% and Ukraine-US mineral deal; Peter Gibbon interrupts from walls, reveals thousand-rat colony named Fival A-D, admits feeding them Case's skin flakes and toilet water, claims he voted for Trump on scrap paper with Christy Brinkley fan art.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Darfus Woodshop Edition — Pizza Faces, Back Cracking, Spanish Accent

segments.title: Rat Homunculus Incident: Fival B Claims to Be Becoming Case
segments.notes: Pepito produces Fival B; rat states it feeds on Case's skin flakes and toilet water, gaining his memories daily; Peter admits homunculus project; Case demands Peter stop; shapeshifting rat form destabilizes into 'Darfus' then fades; Peter apologizes for 'crossing lines' in friendship.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Back-Cracking Failure, Ketamine ED Study, Religion Math
segments.notes: Triggered by 'science'; Chet attempts standing back-crack per wedding singer method, fails due to 'uncrackable back' and khaki pants; ChetAI refuses sexual innuendo; Chet reads ketamine study (long-term use induces erectile dysfunction in rats via nitric oxide synthase); pivots to 'Skions of Religion' — water+wine=Christ, W+W=J=MC².

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Gorilla Pond Fight, Mr. Rogers EDM, Gandalf Professor, Giant Donut, Bernice Repo Crash, Baby Gronk, Off the Leash, Hot Dog Lady, Blastoise DJ

segments.title: Late News with Rick: Portfolio Crash, Grindr Cum Calculator, Fart Walks, Gravity Simulation, Kendall Boston Call
segments.notes: Rick hosts; Case opens 45 tabs, discovers stock portfolio erased; Grindr interactive cum calculator (4ml, 7 calories per load); fart walks improve intestinal mobility per Dr. Tim Pweton; physicist Melvin Vopsen gravity-as-simulation theory (second law of infodynamics); Kendall calls from Boston, Case realizes he's late for 7 PM movie, aborts broadcast.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns after a missed Monday broadcast to a chaotic night: Hype Train derails the cold open with an 18-minute freestyle, Peter Gibbon hijacks the news desk to unveil a homunculus project growing a Case-clone from rats fed the anchor's biological waste, Jeb Nogget appears as a confused woodshop instructor, Chet fails to crack his own back while citing a ketamine erectile dysfunction study, and the Amongst the Web desk reviews a repo-show car crash and baby Gronk content. The broadcast ends abruptly when Kendall calls from Boston revealing Case is 30 minutes late for a movie he thought started at 8 PM.
